user_query: I'm planning a surprise party for my friend and I want to include some chuck jokes in the decorations. Fetch a random joke from the Chuck Norris API and provide me with its category. Also, calculate the love percentage between my friend and his partner using the Love Calculator API.

TaskList.description: Fetch a random Chuck Norris joke from the API and extract its category.
Calculate the love percentage between my friend and his partner using the Love Calculator API, using their names as inputs.
